# clisuite

```go
import "github.com/effective-security/trustyca/api/cli/clisuite"
```

Package clisuite supports CLI tests with fixture\-backed HTTP servers and gRPC mocks.

CapturePrint records the output of a test, with the address of the mock server replaced by "\{server\}". TearDownSuite compares it with the suite's golden file, testdata/prints\_\<suite test\>.txt \(testutils.CheckGolden\); run with TRUSTYCA\_UPDATE\_GOLDEN=1 to rewrite it. Suites share CLI globals \(Cli.AfterApply\), so they must not run in parallel.

TestSuite provides suite for testing HTTP

```go
type TestSuite struct {
    suite.Suite

    // Server is file based Server
    Server *servefiles.Server

    Folder string
    Ctl    *cli.Cli
    // Out is the outpub buffer
    Out bytes.Buffer
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="TestSuite.CapturePrint"></a>
### func \(\*TestSuite\) [CapturePrint](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/cli/clisuite/suite_http.go#L49>)

```go
func (s *TestSuite) CapturePrint()
```

CapturePrint records the output of the current test, to be compared with the suite's golden file in TearDownSuite. The address of the mock server is replaced with a placeholder. A test may capture more than once.
